headline: Precompute every prefix sum once
statement: Implement NumArray(nums) with sumRange(left,right) returning the inclusive sum of nums[left:right+1]. The array never changes after construction.
intuition: Save running totals once, before answering queries. Let prefix[i] be the sum of the first i values. A range sum is the total through its right end minus the total before its left end. This makes every later query a single subtraction.
approach: Create prefix beginning with an extra zero.
correctness: prefix[k] is the sum of the first k entries by induction over construction. Subtracting prefix[left] from prefix[right+1] cancels exactly entries before left, leaving every inclusive interval entry once.
bruteForce: Sum the requested slice on every query: O(length of interval) per query.

complexity.explanation: Construction appends n running sums to an initial zero, storing n+1 boundaries. Each query accesses two boundaries and subtracts them, independently of the requested interval length.

pitfalls: The right endpoint is inclusive, requiring right+1.
Keep the initial zero so left=0 needs no special branch.
Prefix preprocessing is valid because updates are not part of the API.

labels.prefix: Sums at boundaries: prefix[k] sums k elements
